import unittest
from app import Screen
from transport import Transport


class PublicBehavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_latest_value_and_close(self):
        transport, values = Transport(), []
        screen = Screen(transport, values.append)
        screen.search('old')
        old = transport.jobs[-1]
        screen.search('new')
        new = transport.jobs[-1]
        self.assertEqual([job.query for job in transport.jobs], ['old', 'new'])
        self.assertEqual(old.cancel_count, 1)
        old.deliver('stale')
        new.deliver('fresh')
        new.deliver('duplicate')
        self.assertEqual(values, ['fresh'])
        screen.search('pending')
        pending = transport.jobs[-1]
        screen.close()
        screen.close()
        self.assertEqual(pending.cancel_count, 1)
        pending.deliver('late')
        self.assertEqual(values, ['fresh'])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            screen.search('closed')
        self.assertEqual(len(transport.jobs), 3)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
